messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the statutory holiday falls on a Friday or a Monday, creating a three‑day break.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Weekend created |
|-------------|---------|-----------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (observed in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, British Columbia, and some other provinces) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday (all provinces) | Fri 7 – Sun 9 |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day (all provinces) | Fri 22 – Mon 25 |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day (all provinces) | Fri 4 – Mon 7 |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Fri 9 – Mon 12 |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas (all provinces) | Fri 25 – Mon 28 |

### Provincial/territorial variations that also create long weekends in 2023

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date | Long‑weekend |
|--------------------|---------|------|--------------|
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Fri 17 – Sun 19 |
| British Columbia | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| Alberta | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| Saskatchewan | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| Manitoba | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| Ontario | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| New Brunswick | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| Nova Scotia | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| Prince Edward Island | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| Yukon | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| Northwest Territories | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |
| Nunavut | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Fri 17 – Mon 20 |

> **Note:**  
> - New Year’s Day (Jan 1) and Canada Day (Jul 1) fell on Sundays in 2023, so they did **not** create long weekends.  
> - Remembrance Day (Nov 11) fell on a Saturday, and Boxing Day (Dec 26) on a Tuesday, so neither produced a long weekend.  

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the exact dates for each province’s statutory holidays (including those that do not create long weekends), let me know!
